review_scope: Static guard review only. No private configuration read, no model/network calls, and no prior-round changes.
runner_conditions: Use one sequential runner/one ledger owner; the asyncio lock is process-local and does not make concurrent processes safe.
Give the runner an absolute process-level deadline as a backstop; SafeAPI bounds each network wait but does not schedule process shutdown when idle.
Do not call embedding/preflight unnecessarily: the frozen-context controls require completion calls only.
Treat finish_reason=length as an invalid or separately flagged extraction comparison; do not infer chunk-boundary loss from output truncation.

input_limit_recommendation.policy: Measure the fully serialized A/B/C messages before dispatch. Keep 180000 if all fit. If any B/C exceeds it, raise only to a rounded-up bound for the actual prepared conditions, preferably no higher than240000, without truncating or changing conditions.
input_limit_recommendation.reason: Byte-count reservation is intentionally conservative; allowing the complete pre-validated context preserves the ablation and remains subject to the10 CNY global cap.

planned_cost_bounds.note: Loose static ceiling intentionally treats bytes as tokens. Expected actual token counts are far smaller. This is a rate-based estimate, not an invoice; cache discounts are not used for the upper bound.

minor_notes: Output max_tokens validation only checks the upper bound. Controlled runners must supply positive explicit3500 or8192 values.
QUERY_DEADLINE is inherited metadata and is not enforced by this wrapper. Existing official-query gate was already passed in round2; new control scripts should enforce the18:01:14 final deadline.
Seed is not sent; temperature0 does not establish deterministic repeated outputs. Preserve interleaved schedule and report observed variability.

transport_amendment.reason: Avoid stalled heavyweight SDK/LightRAG imports for frozen-context generation controls
transport_amendment.request_body_equivalence: Original logged request shape preserved; extra_body.enable_thinking is flattened into HTTP JSON exactly as the OpenAI SDK extra_body contract specifies. Model/messages/max_tokens/temperature/stream unchanged. Header defaults differ; generation parameters do not.
transport_amendment.response_logging: Generated content, finish_reason, returned model and usage retained; not an entire HTTP payload/header dump.
transport_amendment.nonblocking_note: The wrapper still reads embedding configuration fields although it does not instantiate/use an embedding client. No embedding requests occur.

final_runtime_amendment.change: After successful HTTP200, provider response JSON body is persisted before parsing; request/response headers are not saved.
